message: No rush at all, probably nothing, but the brake pedal feels a bit soft and spongy when stopping.
Happy to wait until next month, just saw ABS_w002 pop up briefly.
Not dramatic, just annoying: driver wiper stalls mid-sweep in the rain.
Customer reports ABS_w002 appeared on highway and brake feel started to...
Charge port latch is acting up and won't always click shut on first...
Brake booster warning appeared, stopping distance feels normal so far, no rush.
Saw BRK_w003 on dash this morning, happy to wait until Friday.
ESP_w003 flashed on wet road, probably nothing.
EPAS_a191 alert came on, steering felt heavy in parking lot.
EPAS_w202 warning briefly showed up, steering wheel pulling slightly left.
Sinking brake pedal at red lights, not dramatic, just wanted to mention it.
Grinding when braking at low speeds, no rush at all.
Driver wiper fails to park and stays in forward line of sight.
Cabin heater takes an extra minute to warm up, super annoying!
Center screen froze once after software update, rebooted fine.
Charge port door squeaks when opening.
Mobile app takes a few tries to wake the car.
Rear window rattle over speed bumps.
Side mirror folding motor sounds slightly loud.
USB-C port in center console stopped charging phone.
